_설명: 2026-11-08 작업 감시기를 컨테이너(teomoony-runner, 리눅스)로 옮기며 — 윈도우용(PowerShell · cmd)으로 적힌 작업 중 계속 쓰는 것의 리눅스판.
컨테이너의 _job_runner.py 만 이 파일을 읽고, 같은 이름이면 _jobs_extra.json 보다 이것이 이긴다. 윈도우 감시기는 안 읽는다.
작업 폴더는 /app/Teomoony/etl · PC 폴더는 /app/Teomoony · /app/Teomoony-f · DB 는 127.0.0.1 의 같은 문(컨테이너 안 socat 이 잇는다).
zg-pull-b-par: cd /app/Teomoony && git checkout -- etl/_jobs_extra.json etl/_jobs_linux.json && git pull --ff-only origin main; git log --oneline -3
zg-pull-f-par: cd /app/Teomoony-f && a=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && git pull --ff-only origin main; b=$(git rev-parse HEAD); git log --oneline -3; if [ "$a" != "$b" ]; then if git diff --name-only $a $b | grep -qE '^(src/|package)'; then echo 'web 다시 켬 (src 바뀜)'; docker restart teomoony-web; sleep 4; docker logs --tail 5 teomoony-web; else echo 'web 그대로 (src 안 바뀜)'; fi; fi
zw-restart-web-par: docker restart teomoony-web; sleep 6; docker ps --filter name=teomoony-web --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}} {{.Ports}}'; docker logs --tail 8 teomoony-web
zd-web-logs-par: docker ps --filter name=teomoony-web --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}} {{.Ports}}'; docker logs --tail 60 teomoony-web
zp-docker-info-par: docker ps --format '{{.Names}} | {{.Image}} | {{.Status}} | {{.Ports}}'; echo '--- stats'; docker stats --no-stream --format '{{.Name}} {{.MemUsage}} {{.CPUPerc}}'
zk-kill-collect-cron-par: pgrep -af 'python collect_cron.py' || echo '없음'; pkill -f 'python collect_cron.py' && echo 끔
zp-runner-ps-par: ps -eo pid,etime,rss,args --sort=-rss | grep -E 'python|socat' | grep -v grep | head -30; free -m
zd-runner-restart: touch _queue/restart.job; echo '다음 바퀴에 감시기가 코드를 다시 읽는다'
zd-rename-par: docker rm -f teomoony-rename 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name teomoony-rename --rm --entrypoint sh -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock -v /run/desktop/mnt/host/c/Project/Teomoony:/app/Teomoony teomoony-runner:1 /app/Teomoony/deploy/runner/rename_project.sh && echo '도우미 띄움 — 결과는 logs/job_*_rename-project.log'
zp-sso-link-par: python svc_sql.py ../deploy/svc/pg/_p_nop.sql "SELECT l.user_id, u.username, u.role, l.\"제공자\", l.\"이름\", (l.\"사진\" IS NOT NULL) AS 사진있음, l.\"마지막\" FROM app.sso_link l JOIN app.app_user u USING (user_id) ORDER BY 1"
zd-docker-prune-par: docker system df; echo '--- prune images (사용 안 하는 것만)'; docker image prune -a -f | tail -3; echo '--- prune build cache'; docker builder prune -a -f | tail -2; docker system df; df -h /app/Teomoony
zd-pg-du-par: docker exec teomoony-svc sh -c 'cd /var/lib/postgresql/data && du -sh base/* pg_wal 2>/dev/null; ls base'; docker exec teomoony-mssql sh -c 'du -sh /var/opt/mssql/data/* 2>/dev/null | sort -h | tail -5'; docker system df -v 2>/dev/null | sed -n "/VOLUME NAME/,/^$/p" | sort -k3 -h | tail -8
zd-mem-limit-par: docker update --memory 4096m --memory-swap 4096m teomoony-mssql && docker update --memory 1536m --memory-swap 1536m teomoony-svc && sleep 20 && docker stats --no-stream --format '{{.Name}} {{.MemUsage}}' teomoony-mssql teomoony-svc teomoony-web teomoony-redis teomoony-runner
zi-pylib-iceberg-par: python --version; pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade --target /app/Teomoony/data/pylib312 'pyiceberg[sql-sqlite,pyarrow]==0.10.0' 'duckdb==1.4.2' 2>&1 | tail -5; PYTHONPATH=/app/Teomoony/data/pylib312 python -c 'import pyiceberg, duckdb, pyarrow; print("OK", pyiceberg.__version__, duckdb.__version__, pyarrow.__version__)'
zi-pylib-yaml-par: python -c 'import yaml; print("yaml 있음", yaml.__version__)' 2>/dev/null || (pip install --no-cache-dir --target /app/Teomoony/data/pylib312 'pyyaml==6.0.3' 2>&1 | tail -2; PYTHONPATH=/app/Teomoony/data/pylib312 python -c 'import yaml; print("yaml 설치", yaml.__version__)')
zq-dqm-rules-par: python dqm_rules.py run && python dqm_rules.py apply && python ms_q.py ../deploy/sql/424_dqm_bowan.sql
